# Vector87.com | Quantitative Intelligence on the Global AI & Data Job Market

> Vector87.com is an open, static data and intelligence hub monitoring the direction of the AI, ML, Data Science, and Analytics job market across S&P 500 corporations, frontier technology leaders, and Europe. Data is aggregated directly from corporate ATS platforms into a local DuckDB analytical warehouse and exported into deterministic static JSON contracts.

## Core Market Data (Snapshot: 2026-11-10)
- **Active AI & Data Job Postings**: 12,499
- **S&P 500 AI/Data Postings**: 6,152 (2.28% of total corporate hiring pool)
- **S&P 500 Enterprise Coverage**: 472 hiring / 508 tracked firms
- **Tracked Occupied Workforce (Headcount)**: 187,585 data/AI team seats across 1900 enterprises
- **Hands-on (IC) to Management Ratio**: 11.2 : 1 (91.79% IC vs 8.21% Management)

## Key Pages & Endpoints
- [Market Dashboard](https://vector87.com/): Core market data covering vitality, cloud stack, S&P 500 sector heatmap, hierarchy ratios, and emerging technology signals.
- [Czech Version / Česká verze](https://vector87.com/cs/): Kompletní zrcadlo v češtině.
- [Role Analysis](https://vector87.com/roles): 21 canonical AI & Data roles with synthesized job descriptions, required competencies, and team expansion velocity.
- [Role & Tech Comparisons](https://vector87.com/compare): Head-to-head empirical comparisons and Venn diagrams (Data Analyst vs Data Scientist, Data Analyst vs Data Engineer, Data Engineer vs Data Scientist, Databricks vs Snowflake, BigQuery vs Snowflake, BI Developer vs Data Analyst, dbt vs Dataform).
- [Technologies & Platforms](https://vector87.com/technologies): In-depth market demand across 20 core data and AI technologies (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Python, SQL, dbt, Spark, GCP).
- [Cloud & Tech Hub](https://vector87.com/cloud-tech): In-depth market demand across cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) and platforms (Databricks, Snowflake).
- [Education Academy](https://vector87.com/academy): 3 structured learning tracks (Analytics Engineering, Cloud Data Engineering, Applied AI/LLMOps) and essential architectural literature.
- [Skill Gap Analyzer](https://vector87.com/academy/analyzer): Interactive career calculator matching your tech stack against 21 canonical roles and recommending targeted courses.
- [Salary Benchmarks](https://vector87.com/salaries): Empirical compensation benchmarks across AI, Data Science, and Engineering roles in the US, UK, Western Europe, and Czech Republic.
- [Podcasts & Media Radar](https://vector87.com/academy/podcasts): Monitored shows, episodes, and executive summaries across data engineering and AI.
- [Conferences Calendar](https://vector87.com/conferences): Curated global and European directory of Data Engineering, Lakehouse, and Applied AI summits with dates, locations, and CFP deadlines.
- [Countries & Relocation Index](https://vector87.com/countries): Future Tracker country ranking (217 countries) assessing quality of life, institutional safety, ease of relocation, and live enterprise Data & AI job opportunities.
- [Country Hubs & Profiles](https://vector87.com/countries/czechia): Dedicated country profiles featuring active local requisitions, top employers, tech meetups, and livability radar.
- [About Author](https://vector87.com/about): Background of Antonín Kučera (akucera.eu), project philosophy, and essays on Data-Informed leadership.

## Machine-Readable Data Contracts
- [JSON Schema](https://vector87.com/schema/market-data.schema.json): Formal draft 2020-12 schema specification.
- [Full Text for LLMs](https://vector87.com/llms-full.txt): Complete uncompressed textual dump of all synthesized role profiles, skills, and hiring data for direct ingestion.
